title: 馬克白 1-3 女巫預言
style_suffix: black and white ink comic style, high contrast, heavy shadows, dark fantasy atmosphere
characters: witch one has a single eye, witch two has a torn grinning mouth, witch three has pale white pupils, all in tattered cloaks and tall battered pointed hats, faces mostly in shadow

panels.prompt: three witches huddled together on a thunderous heath, {characters}, witch one gesturing angrily as she tells a story, the others cackling

dialogue.speaker: 女巫甲
dialogue.text: 一個水手的老婆不肯分我栗子——還罵我「滾開，妖巫」！哼，她丈夫是「猛虎號」的船長……
dialogue.en: 'Aroint thee, witch!' the rump-fed runnion cries. Her husband's to Aleppo gone, master o' the Tiger.

panels.prompt: nightmare vision, a tiny sailing ship tossed on a furious black sea, a hag silhouette riding a sieve among the storm clouds above, lightning veins

dialogue.speaker: 女巫甲
dialogue.text: 我要坐著篩子追上他，讓狂風把海掀起來——終朝終夜不得安，骨瘦如柴血色乾！
dialogue.en: In a sieve I'll thither sail... Sleep shall neither night nor day hang upon his penthouse lid.

panels.prompt: witch one holding up a shriveled severed thumb like a trophy, the other two witches leaning in greedily, {characters}

dialogue.speaker: 女巫甲
dialogue.text: 瞧——歸途翻船淹死的舵工，他的大拇指。
dialogue.en: Here I have a pilot's thumb, wrecked as homeward he did come.

dialogue.speaker: 音效
dialogue.en: DOOM… DOOM…

panels.prompt: three witches joining hands and spinning in a ritual circle, {characters}, fog spiraling around them like a vortex, seen from a low angle

dialogue.speaker: 女巫丙
dialogue.text: 鼓聲！鼓聲！馬克白來了！
dialogue.en: A drum, a drum! Macbeth doth come.

dialogue.speaker: 三女巫（合）
dialogue.text: 手攜手，三姊妹，滄海高山彈指地——三三九轉，蠱就練成！
dialogue.en: The Weird Sisters, hand in hand, posters of the sea and land… Peace! The charm's wound up.

panels.prompt: Macbeth, a broad-shouldered warrior in dark plate armor, shoulder-length black hair, short black beard, a pale diagonal scar across his left cheek, walking beside Banquo, a sturdy warrior with a thick braided beard, a raven feather pinned at his shoulder, both crossing a fog-choked moor after battle, low sun breaking through storm clouds behind them

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 我從沒見過這樣陰鬱、又這樣光明的日子。
dialogue.en: So foul and fair a day I have not seen.

panels.prompt: Banquo, a sturdy warrior with a thick braided beard, a raven feather pinned at his shoulder, recoiling as three withered witches block the foggy path ahead, {characters}, each pressing a bony finger to her cracked lips

dialogue.speaker: 班柯
dialogue.text: 這些是什麼東西？枯瘦成這樣，裝束古怪，不像地上的活物……該是女人吧，可你們的鬍鬚讓我不敢相信。
dialogue.en: What are these, so withered and so wild in their attire… You should be women, and yet your beards forbid me to interpret that you are so.

panels.prompt: Macbeth, a broad-shouldered warrior in dark plate armor, shoulder-length black hair, short black beard, a pale diagonal scar across his left cheek, stepping forward with his hand raised in command, facing the three witches in the fog

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 你們要是能講話——說，你們是什麼人？
dialogue.en: Speak, if you can: what are you?

panels.prompt: close-up of the first witch bowing with mock reverence, a single eye gleaming under her hood

dialogue.speaker: 女巫甲
dialogue.text: 萬福，馬克白！祝福你，葛萊密斯爵士！
dialogue.en: All hail, Macbeth! Hail to thee, Thane of Glamis!

panels.prompt: close-up of the second witch bowing, a torn grinning mouth stretching wider

dialogue.speaker: 女巫乙
dialogue.text: 萬福，馬克白！祝福你，考特爵士！
dialogue.en: All hail, Macbeth! Hail to thee, Thane of Cawdor!

panels.prompt: the third witch pointing a long bony finger directly at the viewer, pale white pupils blazing, a faint spectral crown glowing in the fog above her head

dialogue.speaker: 女巫丙
dialogue.text: 萬福，馬克白——未來的君王！
dialogue.en: All hail, Macbeth, that shalt be king hereafter!

quote.text: 萬福馬克白，未來的君王
quote.en: All hail, Macbeth, that shalt be king hereafter!

panels.prompt: Macbeth frozen stiff, gripping his sword hilt, eyes wide, while Banquo, a sturdy warrior with a thick braided beard, studies his friend's face with concern

dialogue.speaker: 班柯
dialogue.text: 將軍，您怎麼吃驚成這樣？倒像怕這大好的消息。（向女巫）那我呢？我不求恩惠、不怕憎恨——對我說吧。
dialogue.en: Good sir, why do you start and seem to fear things that do sound so fair? … Speak then to me, who neither beg nor fear your favors nor your hate.

panels.prompt: three witches slowly circling Banquo, a sturdy warrior with a thick braided beard, a raven feather pinned at his shoulder, {characters}, pointing at him from three directions in the swirling fog

dialogue.speaker: 女巫甲
dialogue.text: 比馬克白低微，地位卻在他之上。
dialogue.en: Lesser than Macbeth, and greater.

dialogue.speaker: 女巫乙
dialogue.text: 不如他幸運，卻比他更有福。
dialogue.en: Not so happy, yet much happier.

dialogue.speaker: 女巫丙
dialogue.text: 你做不成君王，你的子孫卻將君臨一國。
dialogue.en: Thou shalt get kings, though thou be none.

panels.prompt: Macbeth lunging forward with an outstretched hand, but the three witches are already dissolving into ribbons of mist

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 且慢！考特爵士還活著，君王更是無稽——說！消息從哪來？我命令你們！
dialogue.en: Stay, you imperfect speakers, tell me more! … Speak, I charge you.

panels.prompt: empty heath where the witches stood, only a wisp of fog curling above the grass, two warriors staring at the vacant spot

dialogue.speaker: 班柯
dialogue.text: 水有泡沫，大地也有——她們就是。消失到哪去了？
dialogue.en: The earth hath bubbles, as the water has, and these are of them. Whither are they vanished?

panels.prompt: two warriors exchanging an uneasy sidelong glance, faces half-lit, fog pressing in around them

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 像呼吸一樣，融進風裡了……您的子孫將要做君王。
dialogue.en: Into the air… Your children shall be kings.

dialogue.speaker: 班柯
dialogue.text: 您自己將要做君王。
dialogue.en: You shall be king.

panels.prompt: two riders approaching through the fog in the distance, silhouettes with a royal pennant

dialogue.speaker: 班柯
dialogue.text: 誰來了？
dialogue.en: Who's here?

panels.prompt: thane Ross, a gaunt middle-aged nobleman in a long travel-stained grey cloak, saluting Macbeth solemnly, beside him Angus, a broad-bearded thane in a dark green cloak, holding a sealed royal decree

dialogue.speaker: 洛斯
dialogue.text: 王上聽了你的戰功，高興得說不出話。他命我替你加上——考特爵士的稱號。祝福你，最尊貴的爵士！
dialogue.en: He bade me, from him, call thee Thane of Cawdor: in which addition, hail, most worthy thane, for it is thine.

panels.prompt: close-up of Banquo's shocked face half in shadow, braided beard, eyes darting toward the empty fog where the witches vanished

dialogue.speaker: 班柯
dialogue.text: 什麼！魔鬼居然會說真話？
dialogue.en: What, can the devil speak true?

panels.prompt: close-up of Macbeth's stunned face, a pale diagonal scar across his left cheek, eyes wide in the torch-lit dusk

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白
dialogue.text: 考特爵士還活著——為什麼給我穿上借來的衣服？
dialogue.en: The Thane of Cawdor lives: why do you dress me in borrowed robes?

dialogue.speaker: 安格斯
dialogue.text: 他犯了叛國重罪，親口供認——命在旦夕。
dialogue.en: Treasons capital, confessed and proved, have overthrown him.

panels.prompt: Macbeth, a broad-shouldered warrior in dark plate armor, shoulder-length black hair, short black beard, a pale diagonal scar across his left cheek, standing apart from the others in the foreground, face half-swallowed by shadow, staring down at a dark rain puddle at his feet, inside the puddle his blurred reflection wears a glowing crown, rippling water distorting the reflected image, storm clouds overhead

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白（內心）
dialogue.text: 葛萊密斯，考特……最大的尊榮還在後頭。這啟示不是凶兆，也不像吉兆——可為什麼那個念頭，讓我毛髮悚然、心跳失了常態？
dialogue.en: Glamis, and Thane of Cawdor: the greatest is behind… Why do I yield to that suggestion whose horrid image doth unfix my hair and make my seated heart knock at my ribs?

panels.prompt: over-the-shoulder shot from behind Banquo's braided-bearded head in near foreground, the small distant figure of Macbeth walking away into thick fog, two thanes as faint shapes far behind

dialogue.speaker: 班柯
dialogue.text: 瞧，我們的同伴想得出神了。新尊榮像新衣服——穿慣以前，總不合身。
dialogue.en: Look how our partner's rapt. New honors come upon him, like our strange garments, cleave not to their mold but with the aid of use.

panels.prompt: narrow closing panel, Macbeth's face in profile turning away, the ghost of a smile at the corner of his mouth, fog closing behind him

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白（內心）
dialogue.text: 要是命運要我做君王——也許不用我動手，命運自己會替我加冕。
dialogue.en: If chance will have me king, why, chance may crown me, without my stir.
